# CollectionError

Why a collection operation could not be completed.

```rux
pub enum CollectionError: uint8 {
    IndexOutOfRange = 1
}
```

Every case means the operation did not happen and the collection is as it was.

## Cases

| Name              | Value | Description                               |
| ----------------- | ----- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `IndexOutOfRange` | `1`   | The index was not one the collection has. |
